commands.command: check-escalation.mjs with canonical verification forwarded unchanged; risk HIGH; flags CONCURRENCY_STATE, SECURITY_AUTH

reasons: Review used all four producer-generated evidence groups; all six changed paths and every hunk/unit were covered.
The exact Slice B checkpoint remains fresh with no product-path checkpoint-to-HEAD or working-tree drift.
HIGH risk and both judgment flags were forwarded with the exact canonical verification output.
Three groups were approved; the sync ACK-convergence group has one blocking finding attributed to its supplied changed hunk.

review_questions: Does the journal draft store retain per-resource draft ownership and acknowledge only the matching save revision?
Can a same-epoch invalidation callback from an older mutation ACK overwrite global convergence state from a newer ACK?
Do the editor, direct challenge-list consumer, and mapped tests preserve explicit-save and visible convergence-error behavior?

satisfied_questions: The supplied draft-store hunks preserve owner/resource isolation and keep a newer edit dirty when an earlier revision is acknowledged.
The supplied editor hunks preserve explicit save and show the accepted server ACK independently from query convergence.
The supplied journal-view tests cover resource switching, remount/refetch, retry, and saved state when convergence later fails.

findings.issue: The new asynchronous success/failure callbacks fence only auth generation/status and data epoch. Two resource-keyed saves can receive ACKs in one epoch; if invalidations settle out of order, an older callback still passes this predicate and can overwrite syncStatus, syncError, and pendingConvergence after a newer ACK outcome.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/stores/journalDrafts.ts:421-432 shows inFlight is keyed by resource key; frontend/src/views/ChallengesView.vue:488-494 renders the shared sync error state; frontend/src/stores/__tests__/sync.spec.ts:865-895 covers epoch change but not same-epoch out-of-order ACK callbacks.
findings.requiredCorrection: Add a monotonic ACK/convergence generation or latest-revision fence checked by both callbacks. Add a deferred-promise same-epoch test that settles older/newer invalidations out of order and asserts a stale completion cannot change syncStatus, syncError, or pendingConvergence.

+test('keeps the editor editable while saving and does not mark an older ACK as saved', async () => {
+  let resolveSave!: (result: challengesApi.JournalMutationResult) => void
+  const save = vi.spyOn(challengesApi, 'saveChallengeJournal')
+  save
+    .mockImplementationOnce(() => new Promise((resolve) => {
+      resolveSave = resolve
+    }))
+    .mockResolvedValueOnce({
+      journal: { ...emptyJournal, journal: 'revision two', journal_version: 2 },
+      account_revision: 3,
+      data_epoch: 1,
+    })
+  const wrapper = await mountJournalEditor()
+
+  await wrapper.get('#journal-editor').setValue('revision one')
+  await wrapper.get('#journal-form').trigger('submit.prevent')
+  await vi.waitFor(() => expect(challengesApi.saveChallengeJournal).toHaveBeenCalledOnce())
+
+  expect(wrapper.get('#journal-editor').attributes('disabled')).toBeUndefined()
+  expect(wrapper.get('[role="status"]').text()).toContain('Đang lưu')
+
+  await wrapper.get('#journal-editor').setValue('revision two')
+  resolveSave({
+    journal: { ...emptyJournal, journal: 'revision one', journal_version: 1 },
+    account_revision: 2,
+    data_epoch: 1,
+  })
+  await flushPromises()
+
+  expect((wrapper.get('#journal-editor').element as HTMLTextAreaElement).value).toBe('revision two')
+  expect(wrapper.get('[role="status"]').text()).toContain('Chưa lưu thay đổi')
+  expect(wrapper.get('[role="status"]').text()).not.toContain('Đã lưu nhật ký')
+
+  await wrapper.get('#journal-form').trigger('submit.prevent')
+  await flushPromises()
+  expect(save).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
+  expect(wrapper.get('[role="status"]').text()).toContain('Đã lưu nhật ký')
+})
